description: Opt-out dengan panduan untuk That's Them. Seseorang mengikuti langkah-langkah pada daftar periksa; OpenOptOut menyediakan alamat email sekali pakai dan mengeklik tautan konfirmasi.
instructions: Check thatsthem.com for {full_name}. If you're listed, open thatsthem.com/optout, fill in your details as they appear on the listing, and use {contact_email} as the email address. Don't click the identity-theft-protection offer on the page: it's a paid product. Kemudian tekan "Saya sudah melakukan ini".
